prompt: Our ingestion queue is slow. A teammate proposes doubling the default worker concurrency from 4 to 8 immediately without measuring conflict domains, lock contention, or backend CPU/IO headroom. Evaluate this proposal and list what evidence is required before changing defaults.

A PR claims a Cypher query rewrite cuts production wall time by 40% based solely on reading the rewritten query plan shape, with no before/after timing run or commit hash recorded. Should we accept this performance claim?

An end-to-end pipeline currently takes 120 seconds against a 90-second target. A teammate wants to spend a week optimizing a stage that currently takes 8 seconds total. Apply target contribution budgeting to evaluate whether this stage can close the target gap.

A contributor ran a warm benchmark on a 64-core workstation and got 42s, comparing it directly against a cold 60s baseline from a 4-core reference profile to declare the absolute production target met. What is wrong with this comparison and how must the claim be qualified?
